caption: sky note: "don't date during mars retrograde, it's doomed." not true. mars stations retrograde in virgo on sunday, jan 10.

slides.headline: “anything that starts in *mars retrograde* is doomed”
slides.dek: mars stations retrograde on sunday. let's check the claim first

slides.headline: “don't start dating until mars goes direct. it won't last”
slides.body: nobody has shown that relationships started under mars retrograde end more often. it's a reading, not a statistic. and mars itself isn't doing anything different. it just looks that way from here.

slides.headline: earth is the *faster* car on the inside lane
slides.body: as earth catches up to mars and passes it, mars appears to slow, stop and drift back against the stars. from jan 10 it does that in virgo.

slides.headline: retrograde reads as *slow*, not doomed
slides.body: astrologers read mars retrograde as lower, more tired drive: better for slow starts and second looks than for rushing in. slow is not the same as wrong.

slides.headline: date if you want to. just *go slower*.
slides.body: the honest take: if it ends, it wasn't mars. put your dealbreakers up front and the timing matters less.
